scope_correction.statement_requiring_narrowing: Do not equate the normalized runyu/runxian threshold flag with 'this same civil/regnal year contains a leap month' for arbitrary years.
scope_correction.corrected_scope: The 1569 runyu method is a winter-solstice-centered technical recurrence. Its exact year-label alignment and interaction with true-conjunction winter-boundary cases require separate certification before arbitrary civil-year generation.
scope_correction.reason: A 1368-1644 true-conjunction/Pingqi technical-sui sweep yields four structural tension labels (1384, 1385, 1479, 1480) between the normalized threshold flag and the actual 12-versus-13-new-moon winter-to-winter structure. Received dynastic-history chronology independently confirms civil 1384 as leap tenth month.
scope_correction.consequence: G09 remains open; the leap-existence subrule is no longer described as globally closed for arbitrary civil/regnal-year mapping.

historical_controls.use: Separate civil/regnal-year labeling from winter-solstice technical-sui labeling.

precision_result.finding: Across the complete 277-year sweep, the four 12OX dynamic precision profiles do not change any tested technical-sui month structure or source-day new-moon label.
precision_result.implication: The 12OZ G09 structural tension is not caused by the currently modeled dynamic-precision profile spread.

boundary_ranking.purpose: Rank direct-source acquisition; not historical authority by itself.
boundary_ranking.new_moon_day_boundary: The closest source-day new-moon case is expected at 1425 k=5, within two source units (well under 0.3 minute) of a source-day boundary.
boundary_ranking.zhongqi_new_moon_same_day: The closest same-day Zhongqi/new-moon pair is expected at 1414 z=11 / k=12, under 100 source units (under 0.25 hour) apart.
boundary_ranking.note: 1384 combines a structural threshold/sui tension with a received civil-year leap-10 control; 1479/1480 need direct almanac/reign-record validation.

next_research_priority.focus: Directly adjudicate the technical-sui/civil-year binding at the four 12OZ structural tension labels, beginning with the received 1384 leap-10 control and seeking direct Ming almanac/reign-record evidence for 1479/1480. Re-collate the 1569 推閏餘分法 wording as a formula-level source record before any G09 closure.
